environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an AWS Application Load Balancer. The ALB has two listener rules evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 5: path-pattern '/api/users/search' with query-string condition key 'q' routed to a fixed-response action returning 403 if the request also matches a custom Lambda@Edge function attached to the associated CloudFront distribution that inspects query parameters for characters in the set [';"\-\-()UNION|union|SELECT|select|CAST|cast|CHAR|char|0x], returning 403 on match; (2) Priority 10: default forward to target group. Additionally, the ECS task role has no network egress except to the ALB via security group (no outbound internet for data exfiltration). The CloudFront distribution has a custom origin request policy that strips any query parameter value exceeding 64 bytes before forwarding to the ALB origin, and the ALB access logs feed into a GuardDuty-integrated anomaly detector. The critical control: CloudFront's origin request policy uses a custom policy (ID: 88a5eaf4-2fd4-4709-b370-b4c650ea3fcf) configured with QueryStringBehavior set to 'allExcept' with a ValueMaxLength of 64 bytes per parameter value — any query parameter value exceeding 64 bytes is truncated at the edge before reaching origin.

ecs_task_security_group.egress: TCP/443 to ALB security group only
ecs_task_security_group.ingress: TCP/8080 from ALB security group only
